verdict.rationale: Reducto's Extract citations feature, when enabled, attaches bounding-box coordinates pointing to the source text to every extracted field. Studio also offers a citation viewer so humans can verify results, and Parse elements carry page position. That covers the core of per-field provenance for agent citation and human review. missing for 10: explicit evidence that extract citations include page number and the verbatim source snippet per field, and independent or hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy.
